desc: Betty Crocker Cinnamon Toast Crunch Cookie Mix makes it easy to celebrate fall and winter occasions with the iconic taste of a favorite breakfast cereal. It's an easy cookie mix made with epic cinnamon sugar CINNADUST. This Betty Crocker baking mix goes from bowl to oven in minutes for a home-baked cookie experience that wows family and guests. Just follow the simple mixing and baking instructions on the box for irresistible cookies that become the star of a Thanksgiving food spread, holiday sweets table, or baked goods gift basket. Crave even more iconic cinnamon flavor? Also try Betty Crocker Cinnamon Toast Crunch Frosting as a topping for cookies, cakes, or cupcakes. For more than a century, Betty Crocker has been a popular creator of simple, delicious recipes. Today, the Betty Crocker kitchen is still providing convenient, tasty dessert mixes, frostings, and convenient meal options and side dishes.
features:
HOLIDAY COOKIE MIX: You don't always need a cereal to taste that iconic cinnamon sugar CINNADUST; Cinnamon Toast Crunch Cookie Mix is packed with epic CINNADUST flavor that family and guests will love

EASY BAKING: This easy cookie mix goes from box to oven in minutes following the simple steps on the package; Create cinnamon flavored cookies for fall and holiday parties or impromptu entertaining

FAMILY FAVORITE: Cinnamon cookies are perfect for a Thanksgiving food spread or holiday treats table; CINNADUST flavor is sure to be a hit with everyone

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Add cookies to a dessert bar, baked goods gift basket, or treats care package; Also try CINNADUST Frosting

CONTAINS: One 12.6 oz pouch of Betty Crocker Cinnamon Toast Crunch Cookie Mix

BOX TOPS FOR EDUCATION: Proud to support schools and teachers as an official participating product
ingredients: Sugar, Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Vegetable Oil (palm, palm kernel). Contains 2% or less of: Cinnamon, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate), Salt, Soy Lecithin, Nonfat Milk.
